title: Snowflake Administrator
description:
Job Title: Snowflake Administrator
Primary Location: remote
Position Type: contract

Overview
TalentFish is casting a line for a Snowflake Administrator to support a large healthcare system implementing - Snowflake enterprise data platform. This role will be responsible for Snowflake administration, platform configuration, performance tuning, security, and integration with Informatica, Epic healthcare data systems.
The ideal candidate will have worked as a Snowflake implantation as an Administrator for a large healthcare system, Will have advanced SQL skills, and experience supporting enterprise data environments utilizing Informatica. Healthcare experience is required, particularly working with Epic data.
What You Bring to the Role. (Ideal Experience)

• Snowflake Administration: 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Snowflake environments, including platform configuration, virtual warehouses, databases, schemas, security, performance optimization - Snowflake implementation.

• SQL Expertise: Strong SQL skills, including complex queries, troubleshooting, query optimization, and performance tuning.

• Informatica Integration: Experience supporting Informatica ETL/ELT pipelines, data ingestion, and integration with Snowflake.

• Healthcare / Epic Experience: Experience working with hospital data environments, preferably integrating Epic Clarity, Caboodle, or other Epic data sources into Snowflake.

• Data Security & Governance: Experience with role-based access control (RBAC), data governance, HIPAA requirements, monitoring, and Snowflake cost management.

What You'll Do.

• Administer Snowflake: Configure, maintain, monitor, and optimize Snowflake environments to ensure availability, scalability, security, and performance.

• Support Data Integration: Partner with data engineering teams to support Informatica pipelines and the ingestion of Epic clinical, financial, and operational data into Snowflake.

• Optimize Performance: Monitor workloads, troubleshoot SQL queries, optimize virtual warehouses, and manage Snowflake consumption and costs.

• Manage Security: Implement user access, roles, permissions, data protection, and governance controls aligned with healthcare security and HIPAA requirements.

• Support Implementation & Operations: Collaborate with data architects, BI teams, and hospital IT stakeholders to support Snowflake implementation, data warehouse migration, troubleshooting, and ongoing platform operations.

Compensation Information
Compensation: $50-80/hr (plus benefits we offer healthcare on the first of the month after start date and additional quality benefits programs.
The expected compensation for this position will depend on experience and qualifications. TalentFish is committed to pay transparency and equal opportunity.
Additional Information
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

TalentFish is an employee-owned staffing and consulting firm specializing in technology, data, cybersecurity, and business transformation. We connect exceptional talent with organizations seeking innovative solutions and technical expertise.

title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Azure Infrastructure Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Azure Infrastructure Engineer to design, deploy, and operate large-scale, secure, and resilient cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure. In this role you will own the end-to-end cloud engineering lifecycle, including architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security hardening, cost optimization, observability, and ongoing operational excellence for production workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across Azure services with strong DevOps engineering practices, and will partner closely with application development, security, and SRE teams to deliver cloud-native solutions that meet demanding business requirements for scalability, reliability, and compliance.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on Microsoft Azure in production environments.

• Strong hands-on experience with Azure core services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and platform-as-a-service offerings.

• Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.

• Solid experience designing and operating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters at scale.

• Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD across infrastructure and applications.

• Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation code.

• Deep understanding of cloud security principles, identity management, and compliance frameworks.

• Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies across distributed workloads.

• Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert certification.

• Experience operating hybrid cloud or multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and on-premises infrastructure.

• Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd on AKS.

• Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost-management tooling.

• Experience with regulated environments such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, or FedRAMP.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Yaqeen Institute

Yaqeen is a nonprofit on a mission to pioneer Islamic research in creative, cutting-edge formats tailored to meet people where they are. We work to dismantle doubts through well-researched truths, nurture conviction by strengthening belief with practical, spiritual guidance, and inspire contribution by reviving our tradition of faithful changemakers, insha’Allah . We’re seeking like-minded professionals who embody Islamic values including sincerity, excellence, and compassion, and want to make a difference in the faith of people worldwide.

Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Data Engineer to join our Engineering team. You will design, build, and operate the data platform that powers analytics, research, and product decisions across the organization. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable modeling complex datasets, engineering resilient pipelines, and managing the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will own systems from ingestion and transformation through to the warehouse layer, and you will set the standards that keep our data trustworthy. Beyond building, you will partner closely with analytics, product, and platform teams to define how data moves through the organization and to raise the bar for reliability, quality, and governance.

Key Responsibilities

Data Modelling & Transformation

• Model and structure data for analytical and operational use, owning the transformation layer and its tooling, including dbt

• Design data models that are clear, well documented, and easy for downstream teams to build on

• Define and enforce data contracts and schema standards in collaboration with upstream and downstream engineering teams

Pipelines & Orchestration

• Design and build scalable batch and streaming data pipelines across ETL, ELT, and change data capture patterns

• Orchestrate and schedule workflows using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect

• Ensure pipelines are observable, recoverable, and well instrumented, with monitoring and data quality checks that catch issues before they reach consumers

Data Warehousing & Infrastructure

• Architect and optimize our modern data warehouse, including storage layer design, table formats, and compute and query engine integration

• Provision and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure as code, and manage deployment and container orchestration

• Implement privacy, anonymization, and governance controls to keep sensitive data protected and compliant

Collaboration & Communication

• Participate in planning and requirements discussions to raise data quality and modeling concerns before development starts

• Translate requirements from analysts, researchers, and product engineers into robust data models and reliable delivery

• Keep engineering and the wider organization connected through transparent, timely communication

Qualifications

• Advanced SQL, including performance tuning and complex analytical query design

• Advanced Python for pipeline development, tooling, and automation

• Familiarity and hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, AliCloud, or an equivalent

• Data warehousing: expert knowledge of one modern platform (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift), including architecture, storage layer design, table formats, and compute and query engine integration

• Experience developing and orchestrating data pipelines across ETL, ELT, CDC, and stream processing

• Data modeling and tooling expertise, including dbt

• Experience with modern orchestration tools like Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect

• Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure tooling, including Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes or equivalent

• Experience defining and enforcing data contracts or schema standards in collaborative engineering environments

• Exposure to privacy and anonymization implementations

• Background in a SaaS, startup, or product-led environment is a plus

• Familiarity with data observability and lineage tooling

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

About Invisible

Invisible Technologies makes AI work. Our end-to-end AI platform structures messy data, automates digital workflows, deploys agentic solutions, measures outcomes, and integrates human expertise where it matters most.

Our platform cleans, labels, and structures company data so it is ready for AI. It adapts models to each business and adds human expertise when needed, the same approach we have used to improve models for more than 80% of the world’s top AI companies, including Microsoft, AWS, and Cohere.

Our successes span industries, from supply chain automation for Swiss Gear to AI-enabled naval simulations with SAIC, and validating NBA draft picks for the Charlotte Hornets.

Profitable for more than half a decade, Invisible reached $134M in revenue and ranked as the number two fastest growing AI company on the 2024 Inc. 5000. In September 2025, we raised $100M in growth capital to accelerate our mission of making AI actually work in the enterprise and to advance our platform technology.

About the Role
We're looking for a Director of Engineering to set the technical strategy for Data Labs, the team that builds the benchmarking systems, data pipelines, and RL environments behind our AI training engagements. The frontier labs and enterprises we work with are changing how they train, evaluate, and deploy models every quarter. Your job is to see where that market is going and make sure Data Labs is built for it before our clients ask.
You'll decide which capabilities we invest in, which we standardize into platform, and which we leave to individual engagements. You'll track how training methods, evaluation practices, and data needs are shifting across the industry, and turn that into a technical roadmap and a point of view our commercial and research teams can sell against.
You'll lead a group of engineering managers, forward deployed engineers (FDEs), and senior ICs, and partner closely with applied research, product, and go-to-market leadership. This is a hands-on strategic role. You won't spend much time writing code, but you'll stay close enough to the technical work to make and defend hard architectural calls, and close enough to clients to know which calls matter.

Technical Strategy & Roadmap

• Own the multi-year technical strategy for Data Labs, and translate it into a roadmap tied to where the AI training and evaluation market is heading.

• Decide where to build shared platform versus engagement-specific solutions, weighing reuse against team autonomy so platforms speed teams up rather than creating over-dependency.

• Set architectural direction for benchmarking infrastructure, data pipelines, and RL environments so they stay reproducible, portable across client deployments, and ready for the next generation of training methods.

• Anticipate technical shifts 6-18 months out, such as new post-training techniques, agentic evaluation, and synthetic data, and place the bets that keep Invisible ahead of them.

• Set expectations for how AI is used in design reviews and day-to-day engineering work.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning

• Build a clear, current view of how frontier labs and enterprises are training, evaluating, and deploying models, and what that means for the data and infrastructure they'll need from us.

• Track the competitive landscape across AI data, evaluation, and RL environment providers, and help define where Invisible differentiates.

• Turn client signals, research developments, and market trends into investment recommendations for executive leadership.

• Partner with product and commercial teams to shape new offerings, pricing logic, and the technical story behind them.

Evaluation & Data Strategy

• Define Invisible's point of view on benchmarking and evaluation, including pre- and post-engagement comparisons, capability gap analyses, and regression tracking.

• Engage with technical communities, researchers, and early adopters to spot trends before they go mainstream

Enable AI innovation across the product portfolio

• Partner with product teams to identify high-value opportunities to leverage AI capabilities

• Provide guidance on AI approaches, trade-offs, and best practices without centralizing all decisions

• Help teams understand how their work fits into our broader AI strategy and how to leverage shared capabilities

• Synthesize cross-portfolio learnings and socialize what's working (and what isn't)

Evangelize the AI-observability connection

•

• Articulate Honeycomb's point of view on AI observability both internally and externally

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Kasha

Kasha will disrupt the way that people in emerging markets get the health products they need by turning global health supply chains upside down. We are on our way to becoming Africa’s leading platform for last-mile access to health products and services used by enterprises, consumers, resellers, and health facilities. Kasha focuses on the lower-income mass market population, selling health and household goods and delivering those products to the last mile through our Kasha Agents and logistics networks. Customers can order using an omnichannel mobile platform that is built to be highly accessible around the country, reaching even typically offline customers via our digital channels. Kasha also works with manufacturers and global health organizations, operating as a service channel for visibility on distribution, performance data, consumer insights, and last-mile access. Kasha was founded in July 2016 in Rwanda, and operates in East, South, Central, and West Africa. You can learn more about us at Kasha Global Inc.
About the Role
The Data Scientist will leverage AI/ML-driven predictive analytics to support the development and deployment of Proof-of-Concept (PoC) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) focused on NCD (Non-Communicable Diseases) patient retention, delivery forecasting, behavioral adherence, and AI-powered virtual assistants. The role involves building machine learning models for risk scoring, adherence prediction, and supply chain optimization while integrating insights into existing healthcare and logistics dashboards to improve patient outcomes and operational efficiency. Role can be based in Egypt, Rwanda, Kenya and/or South Africa.
Responsibilities

•
Predictive Analytics & AI Models

• Design and develop AI-driven risk scoring models to identify NCD patients at risk of disengagement.

• Build predictive models to forecast eligibility transitions for improved patient care pathways.

• Implement a Machine Learning-based adherence segmentation model to analyze patient behavior patterns.

Delivery Forecasting & Supply Chain Optimization

• Develop an AI-powered delivery forecasting model to predict medication delivery accuracy and potential delays.

• Integrate predictive insights into logistics and warehouse management systems to improve proactive planning.

AI-Powered Virtual Assistants

• Develop and deploy AI-powered chatbots and virtual assistants for medication reminders, real-time patient engagement, and adherence support.

• Enable self-service patient platforms for medication-related queries and preference management.

Data Engineering & Infrastructure

• Design and optimize Python-based ETL pipelines for data flow between AI models and healthcare dashboards.

• Work with MS Dynamics integrations to enhance AI-driven decision-making in clinical and operational processes.

• Ensure seamless API integrations for real-time data exchange between predictive models and user-facing applications.

Monitoring, Validation & Deployment

• Develop real-time monitoring mechanisms for risk stratification insights and adherence dashboards.

• Optimize CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML model deployment and automate API-based data updates.

• Conduct model validation, A/B testing, and performance tuning to refine PoC models before MVP scaling.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

• Work closely with healthcare professionals, supply chain teams, and DevOps engineers to align AI models with operational needs.

• Provide executive-level data insights through Jupyter notebooks and visualization dashboards.

• Contribute to AI/ML best practices through code reviews, documentation, and team knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

• Machine Learning & AI: Supervised and unsupervised learning, risk prediction models, forecasting algorithms.

• Programming & Data Processing: Python, SQL, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch.

• Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (RDS, Lambda, SageMaker), Google Cloud, or Azure AI services.

• ETL & Data

Build AI that runs inside the world's largest enterprises.

Everyone is building AI. Very few are making it work at enterprise scale.

At Lio, we're building the AI workforce for procurement. Our AI agents automate complex, mission-critical workflows across procurement, logistics, and finance for some of the world's largest companies.

We're looking for a Product Manager - Post-Sales & Customer Value who wants to make enterprise AI genuinely useful at scale.

Getting AI agents into production is only the beginning. What matters is what happens next: Are customers actually using them? Are workflows becoming more efficient? Are we delivering measurable business value?

Your mission is to connect what happens in real customer environments with how we continuously improve our products.

You'll work closely with Implementation Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Customer Success, and our engineering teams to identify adoption barriers, improve existing agents, and turn individual customer learnings into scalable product improvements.

Our engineers own their features and make most product decisions. You won't spend your days managing backlogs, writing lengthy specifications, or assigning tickets.

- Strong communication skills in English; German is a plus.

- A hands-on, customer-first mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

- Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently and solve problems.

title: Superintendent
description:
Tricon is an owner, operator and developer of single-family rental homes in the U.S. and multi-family apartments in Canada. Our commitment to enriching the lives of our employees, residents and local communities underpins Tricon’s culture and business philosophy. We provide high-quality rental housing options for families across the United States and Canada through our technology-enabled operating platform and dedicated on-the-ground operating teams. Our development programs are also delivering thousands of new rental homes and apartments as part of our commitment to help solve the housing supply shortage.
Job Description
The Superintendent is responsible for creating, maintaining, and managing project plans and schedules for all vacant homes within a designated portfolio. This role involves overseeing both in-house technicians and external vendors, resolving project issues, and ensuring quality control for all rehabilitation and turn projects. The Superintendent reports progress and issues to senior management, mentors team members, and ensures that all projects meet company standards.

Must have a valid drivers license. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential duties and responsibilities include the following but are not limited to the job specifications contained herein. Additional duties or job functions that can be performed safely may be required as deemed necessary by supervisory personnel.

• Create, maintain, and manage project plans and schedules for rehabilitation and turn work for all vacant homes in designated portfolio

• Anticipate and resolve project issues and schedule difficulties, escalating when necessary

• Direct and oversee the work performed by both in house technicians and external vendor resources

• Maintain accurate and current records of all rehabilitation and turn projects

• Actively report project issues, delays, status updates and completion to Senior Supervisor

• Proactively participate (with current and accurate information) in weekly status meetings

• Develop scope of work project plans for rehabilitation projects

• Develop scope of work project plans for all turns

• Mentor and inspire direct reports by setting expectations, consistent communication, and one-on-one development

• Act with integrity and demonstrate support for Tricon's values and employees

• Conduct quality control inspections on all field work in progress

• Complete initial close out for all turn and rehabilitation projects ensuring that they meet Tricon quality standards

Qualifications:

• Takes ownership of work product and delivers within tight deadlines

• Ability to work well under pressure, self-manage, and set an example for others

• Experience managing complex projects through to successful completion

• Track record of building respectful relationships with both internal and external team members, vendors, direct reports, leadership, etc

• Passionate problem solver who is proactive, reliable, and resourceful

• Track record of fostering a collaborative team environment

Minimum Requirements:

• Valid drivers license

• High school diploma or GED equivalency

• Excellent Communicator, both verbal and written

• Unrelenting attention to detail with an eye for accuracy and consistency

• Ability to build effective relationships with a wide range of people

• Strong presentation skills

Preferred Attributes:

• Knowledge of Yardi accounting platform a major plus

Physical Demands:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, including:

• Frequently required to sit, talk, and hear.

• Regularly required to stand and move; use hands to grasp, squeeze, finger, handle, and feel; reach, push, and pull with hands and arms; twist; reach overhead; stoop, kneel, squat, bend, and crouch.

• Regularly required to climb and descend stairs and ladders.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Principal Engineer - Contract

About this role

The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022 (Podium, PayPoint, Zuto, RL, OAG Analyser and others).

What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter.

Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.

Your mindset

The mindset is the engine, and it is almost impossible to teach retrospectively. You are outcome obsessed, not output obsessed and you care whether the problem was actually solved - you resist the ego instinct to admire a clever solution and ask whether it was needed at all.

You are intellectually honest about uncertainty, taking a trust-but-verify approach and assuming the surprising bug is the one that will burn. You are deeply pragmatic, which matters at CreateFuture where pace counts: you have outgrown the religious wars about platforms, languages and patterns, you hold opinions loosely, and you decide for the systems in front of you, not the ones you wish you had.

You have a bias toward delivery: the smallest thing that works, then iterate, treating documents and meetings as means to that end.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Content and events. Two engines of Flock's marketing, and you own the execution of both.

Today the marketing team is one Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the brand and website, publishes the content, launches the products and runs up to nine events a year, getting it all out of the door by pushing AI hard. We're doubling the team and backing it with 3.5x the budget.

You're the second person in, owning events and content.

Events. You'll plan the calendar with the Senior Marketing Manager and own delivery: trade shows and conferences, plus our own broker and customer events. On each one you'll set the budget, build the stand, run the day, chase the leads and report on whether it was worth repeating.

Content. You'll shape the strategy with the Senior Marketing Manager, then produce it. Volume and quality both count. LinkedIn and the Flock blog are the priorities, plus video and website copy. The stories sit with underwriting, distribution and product, so getting good material out of busy people is a big part of the job.

AI. Flock runs on AI and we build AI products for customers too. Marketing is held to the same standard. We want you to be the person who brings the newest tool into the office and shows everyone what it does. Brokers and customers still respond to work that feels human, so you'll be someone who writes excellently and still has creative flair.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own social media. Run our social strategy, with LinkedIn as the primary channel: product videos, carousels, infographics, and PDF’s, posted consistently and measured for engagement.

- Create content at volume. Case studies, articles, industry news, thought leadership and product launch material, several times a month.

- Make video. Film and produce videos with our team in and around the office: people stories, product walkthroughs and interviews.

- Deliver events. Work with the Senior Marketing Manager Coordinate and execute our calendar of seven to nine events a year: trade shows, conferences and our own customer and broker events.

- Design your own assets in Claude Design and Figma, to a standard that holds up next to agency work.

- Work with AI daily. Draft, edit, repurpose and scale content with AI tools, applying your own voice and judgement so nothing reads machine-written.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Significant content creation and social media experience, ideally in B2B tech, with measurable results from owning and executing a social strategy.

- A portfolio of work you can share on the spot.

- Strong copywriting and communication, proven in published work.

- A track record organising and coordinating trade shows, conferences or business events, plus internal events for customers and stakeholders.

- Hands-on design skills in Figma and Claude Design. Adobe Creative Cloud would be a bonus.

- Startup pace and ownership: you've worked somewhere small enough to own outcomes end to end, spot what needs improving and act without waiting for a brief.

- Confident, critical use of AI across your marketing work.

Nice to have: video editing experience, and exposure to insurance, fleet or telematics.

title: Field Experience Coordinator- Social Work
description:
The Field Experience Coordinator is the Walden University staff member responsible for working closely with students and field instructors to secure field placements. Field experience coordinators hold an MSW degree.
Under the supervision of the Academic Program Coordinator for Field Experience, the field experience coordinator is also responsible for the following

• Serve as main point of contact for a cohort of students regarding all matters related to field experience, including but not limited to field experience requirements, site search support resources, application process and requirements, registration, and issues that arise during field experience.

• Coordinate with team members in the School’s Office of Field Experience to assist all graduate students who require field experience.

• Work with field site contacts to establish affiliation agreements with each field site. Initiate contact with field site regarding affiliation agreement and work in partnership with university contract administrators and serve as a liaison between university and outside field sites.

• Coordinate completion of site onboarding requirements with students and field sites, as needed.

• Track and maintain field experience resources, policies and procedures, student field experience files, field experience applications, site, and site supervisor information across a variety of platforms.

• Develop and maintain field experience communications to students, faculty, site supervisors, and other parts of the university.

• Assist in training and mentoring new team members.

• Partner with field experience staff members on projects and initiatives that drive the field experience mission, improve service levels and student satisfaction, and accomplish field experience objectives.

• Contacting agency representatives to initiate the agency approval process.

• Supporting students to locate field experience agencies.

• Conducting interviews with agencies to determine if they meet the criteria appropriate for field experience.

• Collecting and reviewing agency field instructor documents to help ensure that the field instructor meets the criteria for supervision.

• Responding to questions from students, field instructors, and agency directors about the field experience.

• Educating students, directors of sites, and field instructors about field policies and expectations.

• Working with the MSW Field Director to facilitate orientations for students.

• Entering and updating student and agency documents and data in the social work database.

• Collaborating with the OALA to help ensure that agency affiliation agreements are completed, if legal negotiations are required.

• Attend meetings with OALA coordinators for collaboration.

• Masters Degree in social work from a CSWE-accredited university required.

• 2+ years of post-MSW practice experience required.

• Experience with student support in a university setting preferred.

• Experience providing academic counseling and advising preferred.

• Experience with Learning Management Systems Preferred.

• Ability to manage high-volume activities with strong attention to detail.

• Commitment to the goals of diversity and social change.

• Ability to work with non-traditional students.

• Ability to assume a leading role in coordinating administrative aspects of the field experience.

• Ability to provide guidance and support in field experience operations.

• Ability to assume a significant role in addressing student questions and concerns about preparing and applying for field experience.

• Ability to participate in residencies, national faculty meetings, and other work-related travel.

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected salary range for this position is between $28.85 and $31.25. Actual pay will be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors

title: Board Chair / Board Director / Trustee
description:
This is a remote position.
Board Chair / Board Director / Trustee
Evergreen Expression of Interest - Rutherford Talent Guild™
Canada · United States · United Kingdom Effective boards depend on prepared, independent judgement, constructive challenge and collective accountability. Rutherford International welcomes expressions of interest from experienced board professionals and accomplished executives preparing for their first board appointment.

This registration is for consideration for future mandates and Rutherford Talent Guild membership. It is not an advertisement for a current vacancy.

Who should register

• Independent and non-executive directors of public, private, family-owned and private equity-backed organisations.

• Board chairs, lead independent directors and committee chairs.

• Executive directors who can distinguish their governance contribution from their management responsibilities.

• Trustees and directors of not-for-profit, charitable, pension and other institutional bodies.

• Experienced executives preparing for a first board appointment who can demonstrate governance-relevant judgement.

Professionals based in Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom may register. Eligibility for a particular appointment depends on the organisation, jurisdiction and requirements of the seat.

The contribution boards rely on

We welcome professionals who can demonstrate the ability to:

• Prepare thoroughly, evaluate material information and test management’s assumptions.

• Exercise independent judgement and challenge clearly and constructively.

• Contribute to oversight of strategy, risk appetite, capital allocation and CEO succession.

• Understand technology and cybersecurity exposure sufficiently to ask informed questions and recognise when specialist advice is needed.

• Recognise, disclose and manage conflicts of interest.

• Support effective collective decisions and follow through on agreed actions.

• Maintain the distinction between governing an organisation and managing its operations.

Chair and committee leadership experience may also include setting effective agendas, encouraging balanced participation, managing disagreement and maintaining a productive relationship with executive leadership.

Relevant experience and qualities

Relevant experience may come from enterprise leadership, finance, law, risk, technology, operations, professional services, the public sector or previous board and trustee appointments.

What matters is evidence of sound judgement in consequential decisions, an understanding of governance responsibilities, and the availability and independence the role demands. Particular appointments may require specialist expertise, credentials or committee experience.

We value preparation, diligence, practical and strategic judgement, candour delivered with tact, openness to contrary evidence and an honest understanding of the limits of one’s expertise. There is no single ideal board personality.

Registration and consideration

Submit your résumé and a brief professional profile through “I’m interested.” Following initial review, a Rutherford curator may invite you to provide further information and undertake the RutherfordINTEL Assessment.

Assessment findings are interpreted alongside your experience, achievements, professional objectives and the requirements of potential mandates. Progression and membership remain subject to curator review.

If your interest is exclusively in advisory-board service, please indicate this when registering; those mandates are considered separately.

Registration does not guarantee membership, representation, an introduction or a board appointment.

title: Sr. Reporting Business Intelligence Analyst
description:

In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining robust reporting packages, optimizing data integration pipelines, and modernizing business intelligence tools. You will ensure high data accuracy, security, and service delivery while serving as a trusted analytical partner to leadership.
Key Responsibilities

•
BI & Report Development: Author, optimize, and deploy operational and analytical reports using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) .

•
ETL & Data Integration: Design, build, and maintain SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages for data extraction, transformation, loading, and batch processes.

•
Financial & Operational Reporting: Generate core financial reconciliation documents for banking and Finance, as well as specialized financial output (e.g., benefit check runs, Explanation of Benefits reports).

•
Data Engineering & Analysis: Write complex T-SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and ad-hoc data loads to support end-user requests across cross-functional departments.

•
System & BI Modernization: Evaluate and recommend modern BI suites, software, and analytics techniques to elevate reporting architecture.

•
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with IT and business units to translate complex operational needs into actionable technical recommendations.
Qualifications & Requirements

•
Experience: 3+ years of dedicated BI, data analysis, and KPI-tracking experience.

•
Reporting & ETL Stack: Hands-on mastery of SSRS (report design, matrix layout, subscriptions) and SSIS (ETL pipeline creation, deployment, scheduling).

•
Database & SQL: Advanced proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server, SSMS, T-SQL query optimization, and Visual Studio.

•
Advanced Excel: Expert-level skills in MS Excel, including dynamic formulas, macros/VBA, pivot tables, and complex data modeling.

•
Infrastructure: 3+ years of experience working with Windows Server environments (Win Server 2012/2016+).

•
Industry & Tools: Familiarity with health/medical benefit plans, financial reporting standards, or ERP/reporting systems (e.g., Crystal Reports, IIS, Dynamics GP/Great Plains) is strongly preferred.

•
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related quantitative field.

title: Talent Partner
description:
WHY FACULTY?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Talent Partner at Faculty, you will own the end-to-end recruitment process, attracting and engaging exceptional talent to power our high-growth business goals. Operating within our People team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers across all levels while driving an inclusive, world-class candidate experience within the commercial space and across our Central Functions.

This is an opportunity to shape our hiring strategy, solve complex talent challenges, and directly contribute to building a world-leading AI organisation.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

- Owning the recruitment lifecycle from initial scoping through to interviewing, offer management, and candidate onboarding.

- Sourcing passive talent creatively across platforms like LinkedIn, networking channels, and referrals to build diverse candidate pipelines.

- Partnering closely with business leaders as a trusted advisor, offering data-backed insights and guiding recruitment strategy.

- Designing structured interview packs and assessment criteria to ensure objective, high-quality hiring decisions.

- Driving diversity and inclusion initiatives throughout every step of the hiring funnel.

- Analysing recruitment data and pipeline metrics to identify bottlenecks and optimize process performance.

- Amplifying Faculty’s employer brand by representing the company at industry events, conferences, and meetups.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

- You bring experience managing end-to-end talent acquisition processes, ideally within a fast-moving, in-house environment within the commercial and/or GTM space.

- You possess strong direct-sourcing skills and know how to leverage modern applicant tracking systems to engage top-tier passive candidates.

- You excel at stakeholder management, building authentic relationships across all levels while balancing support with constructive challenge.

- You take an agile, problem-solving approach to recruitment, adapting quickly to change while upholding high standards of confidentiality and compliance.

- You prioritise quality over volume, demonstrating resilience and a dedication to delivering an outstanding, inclusive candidate experience.

- You are a confident, articulate communicator who thrives as a brand ambassador, passionately sharing our culture and ambition with prospective talent.

OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Initial Talent Screen (30 mins)

2. Introductory interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins)

3. Competency & Scenario based interview (60 mins)

OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. Great workplace experiences don't happen by accident. Someone sets the standard, and someone makes sure it holds. That's you.

You translate the client's vision into a defined programming approach, build trusted relationships with their leadership, and run a high-performing team that delivers something people feel every time they walk in the door.

• You lead through people. You hire well, coach directly, and build a team culture that holds when you're not in the room.

• You're comfortable with the numbers. You build a budget, manage to it, and make the case for investment with confidence.

• You influence without authority. Matrixed relationships, procurement partners, centers of excellence, and client teams don't slow you down. You bring them along.

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Procurement Operations is the front door for buying at Anthropic. We sit inside Finance Operations and own the path from "I need to buy something" to a signed agreement, an accurate purchase order, and clean spend data at month end.

We are hiring a Procurement Operations Business Partner to own that path for the teams that keep Anthropic's offices, people, and physical spaces running. Workplace covers real estate, office build outs and leases, furniture and equipment, facilities services, maintenance, and food and beverage. Security covers physical security: guard services, access control and badging, cameras, and security consulting that protect our offices and people. People covers recruiting agencies and recruiting operations, HR systems, benefits and Total Rewards vendors, and training and development.

You will be the person who makes all of it feel simple to the teams who depend on it and reliable to the Finance stakeholders behind it.

Manage change orders, renewals, and closures over the life of each agreement.

• Handle the mechanics that come with physical work and goods: multi line quotes, deposits, lead times, receiving, and asset handoffs for furniture, fixtures, and equipment.

• Know where a purchase belongs. Not everything in these categories should run through a purchase order, and you help requesters tell the difference between a contract that needs Procurement and spend that belongs on a car

description:
Jobbeschreibung

Als Customer Success Specialist -B2C (m/w/d) übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für eine reibungslose Schnittstellenkommunikation zwischen den Teams B2C, B2B Mid market, vor allem Mentoring & Administration und unseren Kund:innen.

- Betreuung und Inhaltsgenerierung der Community-Plattformen.

title: Annuities Program Director
description:
The Annuities Program Director role is accountable for overseeing and delivering the Fixed Indexed Annuity portfolio. The role needs deep FIA and annuity industry knowledge, proven end-to-end implementation experience, and hands-on experience with FAST and FireLight. When needed, The Program Director works with senior leaders, business sponsors, cross-functional teams and vendors to make sure FIA initiatives deliver the expected business results.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and implement the initiative roadmap to execute FIA strategy and scale the business. Manage the integrated FIA initiative portfolio, which may cover product launches, enhancements, technology, operations and distribution readiness. Set priorities with sponsors based on business value, risk and capacity.

• Secure cross-functional alignment working with Product, Actuarial, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Distribution and Marketing, and drive decisions without direct authority.

• Oversee successful delivery by developing and managing the portfolio through detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, RAID logs, dependencies, and status reports.

• Manage portfolio governance and steering committees. Communicate/present consolidated key insights to Program Sponsors and Senior Management audiences/stakeholders that assist in the understanding of overall health and performance of the program, and any required actions or decisions

• Manage portfolio budgets and forecasts with Finance.

• Oversee third-party vendors and coordinate delivery across multiple vendors.

• Set clear expectations for planning, reporting and escalation, and hold teams accountable for delivery.

• Act as the project manager for priority or complex initiatives, balancing portfolio oversight with hands-on delivery.

• Deep dive into specific initiatives/outcomes to remove roadblocks and solve emerging issues

• Oversee delivery from requirements through testing, UAT, cutover, go-live and stabilization. Bring informed challenge on FAST, FireLight and related integrations.

Success Outcomes

• The FIA portfolio is delivered on its approved scope, timeline, budget and quality.

• Initiatives are delivered on time, with strong quality and stakeholder confidence.

• Project managers and workstreams execute consistently and are clearly accountable.

• Risks and dependencies are raised early and resolved.

• Business, technology, operations and distribution are ready for each launch.

• Leaders get timely, reliable reporting and clear decision points.

• New capabilities move smoothly into business-as-usual operations.

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years leading complex programs or portfolios in financial services.

• FIA subject-matter expertise: Deep knowledge of Fixed Indexed Annuities products, implementation requirements, operational impacts, and industry practices.

• Proven experience delivering FIA or annuity products from concept through launch.

• Hands-on experience with FAST and FireLight. Luma or similar platforms are a plus.

• Experience overseeing several concurrent projects and leading project managers.

• Has personally managed annuity implementation projects, and is comfortable switching between strategic oversight and hands-on execution.

• Strong grounding in Agile, Waterfall and hybrid methods, and in governance and RAID management.

• Hands-on skill with project management tools such as Jira, MS Project or Smartsheet.

• Strong vendor management and executive communication skills.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. PMP or Agile certification preferred.

• We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.

GrowthLoop is hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to win new business with some of the world’s largest brands. You’ll help marketing and data leaders make a clear business case for using agentic AI with the data in their cloud warehouse.

title: Forward Deployed Product Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like - and we're just getting started.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds - which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia - many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact - this is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our customers bring us their support teams’ hardest problems, like a stolen card, a disputed payment or a patient asking about their prescription, in highly regulated environments and at volumes where small mistakes are expensive. Lorikeet's Concierge handles the full lifecycle of customer interactions across channels and systems, following each customer's policies and knowing when to tag in a human.

As a Forward Deployed Product Manager, you'll own a portfolio of growth accounts and the outcomes they drive from Concierge. You'll set the implementation plan with your Forward Deployed Engineer, get each customer live and keep uncovering expansion opportunities as their deployment scales. You'll be the Concierge expert your customers rely on, and you'll teach their teams to build and improve it themselves so they can move faster without waiting on us.

You'll also run each account as a business, growing usage against the contract and knowing where the next expansion opportunity will come from. When you find a problem that keeps coming up across customers, you'll make sure we solve it once rather than five times.

- Automate identity document checks for a money transfer app, catching forged documents faster than human reviewers.

- Invent a new way to verify a locked-out customer, matching a code they send from a linked social account.

- Teach Concierge to retain a customer who wants to cancel, with an offer that fits the business's rules.

title: Associate Paleontologist
description: Overview Energy Environmental Group (EEG) is a full-service environmental consulting firm specializing in all aspects of environmental permitting, inspection, and compliance monitoring. From a project’s inception to its final release, EEG’s knowledgeable staff utilizes a multifaceted plan of action to meet project milestones, maintain compliance regulations, and ensure a successful path to construction completion. Energy Environmental Group is a purpose-driven company. Our core values guide our strategy, performance, and culture. We believe in maintaining an environment where team members can make an impact, grow, and thrive. A place where they find meaning and purpose in doing the important work of ensuring communities have the vital energy, light, and communications to prosper. Our culture is inclusive and welcoming. Our teams are empowered with abundant training, tools, and opportunities to follow their curiosity and ambitions. Everyone has an equal chance to advance. Everyone is supported, respected, and challenged to be their best. We’re always looking for talented and dedicated people to join us and love where they work. Energy Environmental Group is a proud subsidiary of MasTec (NYSE: MTZ), a Fortune 500 Company ranked by Energy News-Record as one of the leading contractors in the country. EEG is part of the MasTec Power Delivery segment. We are certified as a minority-controlled company by the National Minority Suppliers Development Council (NMSDC). Our rich diversity of people and ideas makes us a stronger, more innovative organization. The Associate Paleontologist (II) independently supports paleontological compliance and pre-construction activities for electric transmission, substation, renewable energy and other energy infrastructure projects throughout the United States. This position prepares permit applications, environmental documentation, regulatory analyses and project deliverables while coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams and regulatory agencies to support successful project development. Building upon the foundational skills developed as a Staff Paleontologist (I) , this role requires increasing technical expertise, sound professional judgment and the ability to independently manage routine planning and permitting assignments while contributing to project strategy, mentoring junior staff and supporting successful project delivery. What you will experience in this position Independently support planning and permitting efforts for some of the nation's largest energy infrastructure projects. Develop practical permitting strategies that balance environmental requirements with engineering, construction and client objectives. Coordinate directly with engineers, biologists, cultural resource specialists, environmental compliance teams, clients and regulatory agencies. Prepare environmental documentation and permit applications that directly support project development and construction. title: Account Manager
description:
About Us:
At Reusables, we’re driven by a vision of a waste-free world and recognize the urgent need to address the environmental impact of our current systems and habits. We believe that meaningful change requires institutions to offer frictionless systems that make sustainability effortless and tangible.
What began as a grassroots initiative offering reusable takeout containers to restaurants and cafes in Vancouver, has since grown into an enterprise technology platform reaching institutions across North America. Today, Reusables is helping to eliminate thousands of tonnes of single-use waste each year, empowering businesses to join the journey toward a cleaner, more sustainable future.
As a venture-backed and mission-driven company, we are passionate about making impact at scale. We are a young, weirdly talented group of ‘high-octane’ individuals that are relentlessly focused on the planet, people, and profit - in that order.
About the Role:
You’ll own the client relationship from contract signature through to renewal. You’re the connective tissue between our clients and every internal team: the person who keeps everyone accountable to the onboarding checklist, communicates with confidence when things go sideways, and knows your accounts well enough to spot an opportunity before the client does.
Your contribution is client satisfaction, retention and expansion: making sure clients get real value from Reusables, watching for the signals that point to churn, and finding the opportunities to grow each account.
You’ll sit in our Client Delivery team, which gets clients live and keeps them successful.
Most of our clients are universities, so the year follows the academic calendar: launches cluster ahead of each fall semester, and most renewals follow the end of the academic year. Some travel is required, especially during launch season from August to October, when you’ll be on campus with higher tier clients for their launches.
This is a full-time, permanent, remote position, open to candidates anywhere in the United States. The working hours for this role will be EST or CST.
What You’ll Be Doing:

• Be the primary point of contact for your accounts, from kickoff through renewal

• Know each client’s goals, operations and challenges well enough to offer solutions before they ask

• Customise and run the external kickoff, developed alongside our Hardware and Software teams

• Build and maintain the onboarding checklist as the living record of what we’ve committed to, validate it with internal teams, and agree it with the client, including risks and timelines

• Follow up on progress, escalate blockers, and manage client communication through to launch

• Own the post-launch check-in cadence and keep a current view of every account’s health

• Catch risks early and fix them before they reach the client

• Find upsell and expansion opportunities, and own renewals and contract extensions end to end

• Share feedback, friction points and patterns with Product and leadership

• Own client communication on high-severity issues, working with Product on timeline and resolution

• Flag scope creep to Product, and use the onboarding history to find root causes when issues arise
How Your Year Looks:

• May to July: Kickoffs and onboarding for fall launches, and renewal conversations as the academic year closes

• August to October: Launches (some on client site), early check-ins and fixing anything that slows adoption

• November to February: Regular check-ins, account health reviews and the smaller off-cycle renewals

• March to April: End-of-semester reviews, some launches, and renewal and expansion work for the next academic year
What You’ll Bring To The Team:

• Account management or customer success experience with B2B clients, from onboarding through renewal

• You’ve owned renewals and expansion conversations

• You’ve run onboarding or implementation projects that involve several internal teams

• Clear, plain-language communication

title: Senior Backend Go Developer
description:
Role description and responsibilities

You will become a member of a global Tech team located in Oslo, Helsingborg and Lisbon, building a multilanguage, highly scalable, cloud native, multi market broker and membership platform.

Owns significant backend features end-to-end on the One Platform core of the Money & Volume business - Go services on AWS. Works in an AI-First engineering culture where Claude Code and AI-assisted development are daily workflow, not optional extras. Bridges product thinking, strong  architecture instincts, and practical delivery: shipping multiple features a week while maintaining the quality standard  that financial data demands. Contributes to architectural direction, shares knowledge with peers (we learn together rather than in a hierarchy) and collaborates across product, front-end, data and our bank partners' integration teams.

How we build: One Platform is an event-driven, cloud-native platform - Go services on AWS Lambda with EventBridge and SQS, relational data on RDS, infrastructure as code, trunk-based development and a green pipeline as table stakes. It carries ~1.5M applications a year through bank integrations in four markets, and it is being connected to the group's Central Customer Platform (CCP), which provides shared customer identity and single sign-on across the Axo brands. AI-assisted development is the default daily workflow, and much of what we ship goes out flag-gated so we can measure it - and may be deleted once the data speaks. Experiments exist to move commercial outcomes (submissions, approvals, disbursements, gross profit - not engagement for its own sake)

We are not looking for someone who has memorized this exact setup - it is bespoke. We want someone with the underlying instincts (clear domain boundaries, idempotent event handling, data-model discipline, knowing when to experiment vs. when to build to last) who is energized rather than unsettled by an opinionated architecture. 

Your responsibilities will grow to match your abilities and experience.

• Own complete backend feature development from spec through deployment - Go services on AWS
•  Lead architectural discussions and document the decisions that matter - in the lightest form that does the job
•  Build and review AI agent workflows using Claude Code, or equivalent tools - delegate implementation, review all output
•  Design and operate scalable, event-driven services - APIs, queues and jobs (Go on Lambda, EventBridge, SQS)
•  Integrate with partner banks, credit data providers, the Central Customer Platform (CCP) and internal platform services
•  Instrument what you ship and read the results - event tracking, experiment readouts, and the judgment to drop what did not move the number
•  Enforce GDPR and EU AI Act compliance requirements in every feature - data privacy is architecture, not a checkbox
•   Share knowledge with peers - reviews, pairing, showing how you solved something; set the bar for code quality and AI-assisted development practices

Qualifications
Must have:

AI Tooling & Development Workflow

• Strong motivation to make AI-assisted development their primary workflow - agentic coding (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) is our daily way of working, and the candidate must be eager to learn and master it
• Structured, critical approach to AI-assisted engineering: analyses the problem, proactively gathers the information a plan needs, plans the solution and picks the right tool for the job - then reviews all AI generated output critically rather than accepting it
• Judgment about method: knows when a change needs a written plan and when it is too small or too unshaped for one - matches the process to the problem, not the other way round

Backend - Go

• 5+ years backend experience; 2+ years of production Go strongly preferred - strong backend engineers from an adjacent typed/compiled language (e.g. Rust, Java, C#, Kotlin) willing to move to Go will be  considered
• Strong command of Go concurre

• 3+ years of other experience in relevant security roles, such as Security Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Risk Management, Compliance, or Technical Account Management.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, especially when customer-facing. Ability to collaborate and communicate with technical and non-technical audiences alike.

• Conversational familiarity with cloud-native security controls in AWS or GCP.

title: Consulting Dermatologist - Central Rater & Reviewer (Turkey)
description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate , we help improve the quality and reliability of clinical trial data by providing specialized clinical assessment, training, and quality oversight solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies around the world.
Our team partners with sponsors and research sites to support the consistent administration, scoring, and review of clinical outcome assessments across global clinical trials. Through services including central scoring, central review, image-based review, rater training and certification, calibration, and quality review and remediation, we help reduce variability, strengthen data quality, and ensure greater confidence in clinical trial endpoints.
Our work spans multiple therapeutic areas, including dermatology, where we engage experienced clinicians to bring indication-specific and scale-specific expertise to clinical trial programs. Our experts help ensure assessments are performed and evaluated consistently, from training and certifying site raters to centrally reviewing scores and images and identifying opportunities for remediation.
Our global team brings together clinical, scientific, operational, data, and technology expertise to solve complex challenges in clinical trials. At Cogstate , our goal is simple: to help sponsors generate high-quality, reliable data that supports confident decision-making throughout clinical development.
About the Clinician Network
By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.
Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.
About the Role
Cogstate is seeking experienced Dermatologists to support clinical research studies through a range of centralized assessment and quality oversight services. In this fully remote, contract-based role, clinicians may perform Central Scoring, Central Review, Image-Based Review, Site Rater Training & Certification, Calibration Activities, and Quality Review & Remediation across a variety of dermatology clinical trials.
Cogstate provides comprehensive, fully compensated training on study protocols, scoring methodologies, review processes, and operational requirements before clinicians begin study work. Ongoing calibration exercises and quality oversight activities help ensure consistency, reliability, and regulatory compliance across all study assessments.
Depending on study needs and individual expertise, consultants may contribute to one or more service areas, including:

•
Central Scoring: Independent scoring and interpretation of dermatology-specific clinician-reported and observer-reported outcome measures.

•
Central Review: Secondary review of completed assessments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and protocol adherence.

•
Image-Based Review: Evaluation of clinical photographs and imaging data to assess disease severity, treatment response, and endpoint compliance.

•
Site Rater Training & Certification: Training, certifying, and supporting site-based raters on proper scale administration and scoring procedures.

•
Calibration Activities: Participating in ongoing calibration exercises to maintain inter-rater reliability and scoring consistency across global studies.

•
Quality Review & Remediation: Identifying assessment quality issues, providing corrective feedback, and supporting remediation efforts to improve data quality and protocol compliance.

These are fully-remote, contract positions. Work is provided on an as-needed basis and scheduled according to clinician availability.
Qualifications & Expertise

• MD or DO with specialization in Dermatology.

• Board-certified or board-eligible Dermatologist preferred.
